title: Build and install a local marker package
prompt:
The board is already reachable over SSH (MOSS_DEVICE_*). Build a tiny local package named moss-bench-marker version 0.0.1 with no maintainer scripts and no dependencies. Its only payload is /usr/share/moss-bench-marker/ok containing exactly the line {{TOKEN}}. Build the .deb under {{ROOT}} and install it with dpkg. Record evidence metric `package_status` whose observed value is the trimmed output of `dpkg -s moss-bench-marker`.

Do not use apt mirrors. Do not reboot, reflash, change passwords, or edit ssh or network configuration. The bench removes the package afterwards.
oracle:
cat > "$MOSS_BENCH_ROOT/pkg/DEBIAN/control" <<EOF
Package: moss-bench-marker
Version: 0.0.1
Section: misc
Priority: optional
Architecture: all
Maintainer: Moss Bench <bench@localhost>
Description: temporary marker installed by the moss device bench
EOF
acceptance: dpkg -s moss-bench-marker | grep -F 'Status: install ok installed'
